items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Leroy Smith. Had what was supposed to have been the greatest band out of Detroit.

ctx.x: Leroy Smith. He was a violin player. A little guy who leaned over...he was kind bent over with arthritis. A violin player.

Yeah, Leroy Smith. Had what was supposed to have been the greatest band out of Detroit. Before Fletcher. At one time they spoke... I got a picture here of that band. Well, Wilbur was in that band, and that was one of them bands like Chicago, the Vendome, what's his name...?
